Interface PictureInPictureController.SessionPictureInPicture.Delegate

  • Method Details

    • onEnterPictureInPicture

      @UiThread default void onEnterPictureInPicture(@NonNull GeckoSession session, @NonNull String placementToken)
      Called when the page loaded in session requests picture-in-picture.

      If the window is already showing a video from another session, call PictureInPictureController.SessionPictureInPicture.exit() on that session before replacing it.

      Parameters:
      session - The session the video belongs to.
      placementToken - Token that opens the picture-in-picture session where it can clone the video, passed to GeckoSessionSettings.Builder.pictureInPictureToken(java.lang.String). It opens a single session and is only good until this request is answered or superseded. Might be empty if Gecko failed to generate one, in which case no window should be opened.

    • onExitPictureInPicture

      @UiThread default void onExitPictureInPicture(@NonNull GeckoSession session)
      Called when the picture-in-picture window created for session should be closed.
      Parameters:
      session - The session the picture-in-picture window was created for.
